core_obligations: Write the characterising relation: set the classes obtained by capping with the Chern classes of the sheaf, and record their characterising relation on the projective bundle of that sheaf (proof lines 7452-7461).

Pull the relation back: form the fibre product diagram with the projective bundle of the pulled back sheaf, note that the twisting sheaf is pulled back, apply flat pullback to the relation, and use compatibility of the cap with a first Chern class and with composition of flat pullbacks to rewrite the result as the same relation for the pulled back classes (proof lines 7462-7479).
Conclude by uniqueness: the characterisation identifies the pulled back classes with the caps of the Chern classes of the pulled back sheaf, which is the assertion (proof lines 7480-7481).
proof_roadmap: Characterising relation for the caps (proof lines 7452-7461).
Pull back along the morphism of projective bundles (proof lines 7462-7479).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula for an arbitrary Chern class against flat pullback (statement lines 7439-7450, tag 02SK-adjacent). The proof records the characterising relation for the classes obtained by capping with the Chern classes, pulls that relation back along the morphism between the projective bundles using compatibility of the cap with a first Chern class and with composition of flat pullbacks, and identifies the result by the uniqueness in the characterisation. The pullback of the relation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
